## QA checklist (see docs/qa-checklist.md)

- [ ] Copy is approved and no placeholder text remains
- [ ] No invented claims, pricing, testimonials, or credentials
- [ ] Unique title and meta description; correct canonical
- [ ] Index/noindex and sitemap inclusion are intentional
- [ ] Schema matches visible content
- [ ] One H1, logical heading order, internal links present
- [ ] Images have alt text; mobile layout and keyboard navigation work
- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, build)
